title: Paraisten asumispalveluyksikkö, KVR-urakka
description: Paraisten asumispalveluyksikkö, KVR-urakka Hankinnan kohteena on Paraisten asumispalveluyksikön ikääntyneiden palvelujen uudisrakennushanke Paraisilla. Uudisrakennus korvaa nykyisen Koivukodon palveluasumisen asunnot. Korvaava rakennus sisältää 45 ympärivuorokautisen palveluasumisen asuntoa ja 15 yhteisöllisen asumisen asuntoa. Hanke noudattaa hyväksyttyä palveluverkkosuunnitelmaa. Rakennuksen suunnittelussa ja toteutuksessa tulee huomioida sekä ympärivuorokautisen palveluasumisen että yhteisöllisen asumisen toiminnalliset erityisvaatimukset. Kohteen suunnittelussa ja toteutuksessa korostuvat erityisesti ikääntyneiden henkilöiden toimintakyvyn, esteettömyyden, turvallisuuden, tilamitoituksen, asumisen, hoivan ja henkilöstön työskentelyolosuhteiden yhteensovittaminen. Kohteen tilaajana ja rakennuttajana toimii Varsinais- Suomen hyvinvointialue.,

title: ADR Vehicular Equipment Toolkits
description: In Accordance With Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) FAR 5.201, this pre-solicitation notice is a synopsis for Solicitation W912CH-27-B-A025 announcing the Army Contracting Command-Detroit Arsenal (ACC-DTA) intent to issue an Invitation for Bids (IFB) to award a single, five-year, Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Requirements-type contract for Toolkits, ADR Vehicular Equipment. This procurement is 100% Set-Aside for Total Small Business. The ADR Vehicular Equipment Toolkit is a standardized kit to ensure compliance with the Agreement concerning the International Carriage of Dangerous Goods by Road (ADR) treaty during operations in reciprocating nations. A significant capability gap currently exists, as operators transporting hazardous materials (HAZMAT) lack a pre-packaged solution for emergency response. These kits are required across a diverse fleet of logistical and tactical vehicles, including Heavy Expanded Mobility Tactical Truck (HEMTT), Palletized Loading System (PLS), and Family of Medium Tactical Vehicles (FMTV) variants, as well as M915 Line Haulers and various military trailers and tankers. Fielding these toolkits is essential to mitigate this gap and ensure operator safety, protect the public, prevent environmental damage, and maintain legal operational compliance.The notice emphasizes that this announcement is not a solicitation and that proposals are not being requested currently. Interested parties must monitor the Government-wide Point of Entry for the future release of the full solicitation and amendments. Proposal submission will be required through the PIEE Solicitation Module, and vendors are strongly encouraged to register and obtain proper access in advance. All inquiries must be directed to the identified Contract Specialist via email.

title: OutSystems Services - Dynamic Purchasing System
description: The Authority has established a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Outsystems Services including Support, Maintenance, Application Development, Client-Side Support and Continuous Improvement. The DPS is split into two (2) lots: Lot 1 - Projects Lot 2 - Digital Resources . No form of volume guarantee has been granted by the Authority. The Authority shall not be bound to order any of the services referred to within each lot description. The DPS will be open to entrants throughout its life who meet the minimum criteria. Suppliers should note that the Authority may incorporate a preferred bidder stage in their invitation to tender process to allow them to carry out appropriate due diligence on the preferred supplier. The Authority will have the right to request evidence that entry criteria is still valid at any point during the life of the Dynamic Purchasing System with evidence to be provided via an updated SPD to the Authority within 5 working days of request being issued. There will be an ongoing requirement for suppliers to provide management information on call-off contracts awarded under this DPS. Suppliers should be aware that there may be a requirement to indicate the names and professional qualifications of the staff assigned to performing the contract at any subsequent Call-Off DPS call-offs may require the mandated payment of the Real Living Wage as a special contract condition, this will be determined on an individual call-off basis. It is intended that the terms and conditions applicable to Call-Offs will be the Scottish Government ICT Model Services Contract. The Terms and Conditions will be refined for each applicable Call-Off. Interested parties can apply for either or both lots. Interested parties do not need to meet all elements of the scope detailed within each lot to be awarded a place.

title: Germany – Engineering services – Sanierung und Ertüchtigung der Kläranlage der Stadt Greding - Ingenieurleistungen Objekt- und Fachplanung zur Gesamtplanung der Kläranlage
description: Die Stadt Greding plant die Sanierung und Ertüchtigung der Kläranlage Greding. Die Abwasserbehandlung der Kläranlage Greding ist seit Inbetriebnahme 1986 im Wesentlichen unverändert. Die Aufnahme des baulichen, sowie maschinen- und elektrotechnischen Bestands der Kläranlage innerhalb einer Studie zeigte u.a., dass die biologische Stufe der Kläranlage Greding erweitert bzw. saniert werden muss, um auch zukünftig eine gesicherte Abwasserreinigung zu gewährleisten. Der Neubau einer Belebung wurde untersucht. Es liegt eine Vorplanung mit Varianten einschl. Kostenschätzung vor. Im Ergebnis hat sich der Stadtrat Greding dazu entschieden, die Variante „Neubau Belebung mit getrennter anaerober Schlammstabilisierung und Ersatz der Kaltfaulung durch beheizte Faulbehälter“ weiterzuverfolgen. Die Gesamtkosten hierfür werden vorläufig 9,9 Mio. € brutto geschätzt. Eine Beschreibung im Detail kann den Vergabeunterlagen - Anlage 01 entnommen werden.

description: La Communauté d'Agglomération Valence Romans Agglo souhaite réaliser une nouvelle Unité Centrale de Production (UCP) destinée au service commun de restauration collective, chemin Joseph Astier à Valence. Cette nouvelle unité a vocation à regrouper trois cuisines existantes et à assurer une production comprise entre 8 000 et 10 000 repas par jour, avec une capacité d'évolution ultérieure. Le recours au marché de conception-réalisation est justifié pour cette opération par un motif d'ordre technique lié à la destination de l'ouvrage : son utilisation conditionne sa conception, sa réalisation et sa mise en oeuvre. Le marché comporte également une partie de fourniture et pose d'équipements industriels, comprise en phase réalisation. Il s'agit d'un marché à tranches dans lequel la tranche ferme comprend la conception-réalisation de la cuisine centrale et la conception et réalisation des ouvrages nécessaires à la compatibilité d'une extension. La tranche optionnelle comprend la conception et la réalisation d'une extension apte à accueillir un conditionnement en dur des repas

description: PRESOLICITATION NOTICE Install Temporary Shoring in Crawl Space at Building 1 Bay Pines VAMC Set aside for service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB) This procurement is set-aside pursuant to an order of priority established in 38 U.S.C. 8127. Please refer to the attachments section to access the updated documents. ________________________________________________________________________ Description The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), Public Buildings Service, Capital Projects Contracting Division, is pleased to announce the issuance of a Request for Proposals (RFP) for a highly qualified Contractor who can provide Construction Services to perform a Seismic Retrofit at the Clemente Ruiz Nazario U.S. Courthouse (Nazario Courthouse) located at 150 Carlos Chardon Avenue in San Juan, Puerto Rico. The Nazario Courthouse will remain fully operational throughout the duration of the Seismic Retrofit. To ensure minimal disruption to Government operations, the work will predominantly be executed after business hours. The selected General Contractor will be required to ensure full compliance with the Government�s requirements for access and security. Additionally, the General Contractor will be required to complete this project in accordance with the construction drawings and specifications that will be issued for this project. Contract Type: The contract type for this procurement will be Firm-Fixed price. The line item schedule will include a lump sum item for the Base and Options. Price: The total magnitude of this project at award is between $40,000,000 and $50,000,000. Selection and Schedule: The General Contractor will be selected through a procurement method developed in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) Part 15 Contracting by Negotiation (Class Deviation RFO-2025-15) and FAR 36 Construction and Architect-Engineer Contracts (GSA Class Deviation RFO-2025-36). The intended project delivery method is a Phased Acquisition procurement using a Two-Phase Evaluation process. During Phase I, prospective firms must submit technical qualifications detailing their experience with comparable efforts and previous records of past-performance. In Phase II, selected General Contractors shall demonstrate their operational strategy and planned subcontracting framework. Evaluation of Phase II technical submissions will be conducted in full before the Government reviews the price proposal. GSA anticipates award of a contract for these services in August 2027. The period of performance for the proposed contract will be for approximately forty six (46) months upon issuance of notice to proceed. NAICS: This procurement will be conducted under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code 236220--Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The Small Business size standard is an average annual sales and receipts for the past three (3) years that are equal to or less than $45,000,000. All offerors are required to have an active registration in the System for Award Management (www.SAM.gov) at the time of offer submission, and shall continue to be registered until time of award, during performance, and through final payment of any contract. Interested offerors - See all attached solicitation file packages for full details. Some of the solicitation documents are Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). To access these documents your company must request access through www.sam.gov. Proposals for this Solicitation must be submitted via e-mail in portable document format (PDF). Proposals MUST BE RECEIVED NO LATER THAN stated due date and time in this solicitation. Inquiries concerning this solicitation must be routed to Contracting Officer Natalia Lugo-Vina at natalia.lugo-vinacruz.gsa.gov. Prospective offerors bear sole responsibility for tracking and retrieving the RFP alongside all associated modifications.

title: Construct Egress JBPHH HI
description: Contract Description: Construct Egress Shop. This project requires all labor, tools, equipment, transportation, and supervision; as required for the project elements as described in the attached specifications and plans to perform construction services for Project No. KNMD209087 Construct Egress Shop, JBPHH-HI, 96853. This action is being solicited as a set-aside 100% for Small Business. NAICS Code 236220 is applicable to this acquisition, $45M is the small business size standard. The magnitude of construction is between $10M and $14M. A single firm fixed price award is contemplated. . This project has a statutory cost limitation $14M for Unspecified Minor Military Construction (UMMC) Project - Adjustment of Dollar Limitations for Location pursuant to 10 USC Section 2805. Failure to submit an offer on all items shall result in rejection of the proposal. Solicitation and all information, notices, amendments for this solicitation will be posted at https://sam.gov/. Instructions for obtaining plans and specifications and other secured documents for this solicitation are located in Section 00 21 00. Award will be made to the offeror who represents the best value to the Government as outlined in accordance with the criteria set forth within the solicitation. Funds are not presently available for this acquisition. Work covered in this project includes but is not limited to: the construction of a new 3,201 SF Egress Maintenance facility utilizing conventional design and construction methods to accommodate the mission of the facility. Facilities will be designed as permanent construction in accordance with the DoD Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC) 1-200-01, General Building Requirements and UFC 1-200-02, High Performance and Sustainable Building Requirements. The facility should be compatible with applicable DoD, Air Force, and base design standards. Local materials and construction techniques shall be used where cost effective. This project will comply with DoD antiterrorism/force protection (AT/FP) requirements per unified facilities criteria. Structural Systems: Specialized foundations to include a micro-pile foundation system and increased facility elevation to meet the tsunami and flooding requirements of the UFC. Safety and Electrical: Anti-explosive electrical components, and comprehensive maintenance facility lightning and grounding protection. Site Improvements: Asphalt pavements to provide access to the new facility, concrete Aerospace Ground Equipment (AGE) Ready Pad, and a concrete Gas Oxygen (GOX) canopy shelter pad with required connections for power and communications. Utilities: Necessary utility infrastructure hookups including water, sanitary sewer, storm sewer, telecommunications, and electrical connections. All work shall be completed in accordance with Government supplied drawings, specifications, and the contract. The Contractor must coordinate with the HIANG, 154th Civil Engineer Squadron (154 CES) to access the work site as well as coordinate with the HIANG CES environmental section for any hazardous materials storage/disposal. It will be the responsibility of the Contractor to restore the facilities to their original condition if any damage occurs during construction.The source selection process will be conducted in accordance with the Source Selection Procedures described in FAR 15.2, DFARS 215.2, and AFARS 5115.2. Evaluation factors include Technical Capability, Past Performance and Price. The Government intends to award a contract without conducting discussions. Interested offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM). To register go to www.SAM.gov. Instructions for registering are on the web page (there is no fee for registration). The solicitation and associated information will be available only from the Contract Opportunities page at SAM.gov. The solicitation and associated information will be posted within Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) Solicitation Module and subsequently uploaded into the Contract Opportunities page at SAM.gov. Per the solicitation requirements, Offerors are required to submit their proposals through the vendor portal for solicitations within the PIEE platform. A Proposal Manager role is required to submit an offer to a solicitation posted in the PIEE Solicitation Module. A PIEE Solicitation Module Vendor Access Instructions is attached. If your company is new to PIEE and has no Account Administrator, the link below provides the general steps in getting started as a vendor to use the PIEE Solicitation Module and other PIEE applications: https://pieetraining.eb.mil/wbt/xhtml/wbt/portal/overview/vendorRegister.xhtml. This solicitation is not an invitation for bids and there will not be a formal public bid opening. All inquiries must be in writing, preferably via email to the persons specified in the solicitation. All answers will be provided in writing via posting to SAM.gov. If you have any questions concerning this procurement you are encouraged to email your questions to clesson.k.paet.civ@army.mil and copy to anthony.g.reyes1.civ@army.mil. Your attention is directed to FAR clause 52.219-14(e)(3) (DEVIATION 2021-O0008), LIMITATIONS ON SUBCONTRACTING, which states -By submission of an offer and execution of a contract, the Offeror/Contractor agrees in performance of the contract for General construction, it will not pay more than 85 percent of the amount paid by the Government for contract performance, excluding the cost of materials, to subcontractors that are not similarly situated entities. Any work that a similarly situated entity further subcontracts will count towards the prime contractors 85 percent subcontract amount that cannot be exceeded-. In accordance with RFO FAR 36.101-4, the following information is provided: (a) There are no agency-specific policies or procedures that apply to the definitization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts. (b) No data is available regarding the timely definitization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts. Websites are occasionally inaccessible for various reasons. The Government is not responsible for any loss of Internet connectivity or for an offerors inability to access the documents posted on the referenced web pages. The Government will not issue paper copies.

title: Installation d'un nouveau système de feux de signalisation 3000-027 (076) à la Guisanplatz, à Berne (unité de commande comprise)
description:
Compte tenu du projet de développement dans le cadre du pôle de développement (ESP) de Wankdorf, il faut s'attendre à une augmentation du trafic aux abords de la Guisanplatz. Ce carrefour ayant déjà atteint ses limites de capacité, des mesures s’imposent afin de garantir une circulation fluide et sûre pour tous les usagers de la route.


En règle générale, le nouvel arrêt « Papiermühlestrasse » sera désormais desservi sans boucle de tramway ; lors de grands événements, on recourra à l’arrêt existant et éprouvé de la Guisanplatz. Outre la construction d’une voie entièrement nouvelle, il s’agit de mettre en place des équipements à la pointe de la technologie pour les usagers de la route, ce qui implique notamment la mise en œuvre systématique de l’espace sans obstacle (UHR) ainsi que des adaptations de la signalisation routière existante, en particulier sur les pistes cyclables.


Dans le cadre de ces travaux de rénovation, les feux de signalisation seront également entièrement renouvelés (commande, installation extérieure, détection, câblage et raccordement au calculateur de trafic).

Los servicios efectuados se acreditarán mediante certificados expedidos o visados por el órgano competente, cuando el destinatario sea una entidad del sector público; cuando el destinatario sea un sujeto privado, mediante un certificado expedido por este o, a falta de este certificado, mediante una declaración del empresario acompañado de los documentos obrantes en poder del mismo que acrediten la realización de la prestación; en su caso estos certificados serán comunicados directamente al órgano de contratación por la autoridad competente. La acreditación de la solvencia técnica o profesional se efectuará mediante la relación de los principales suministros efectuados, en los tres últimos años, de igual o similar naturaleza que los que constituyen el objeto del contrato, cuyo importe anual acumulado en el año de mayor ejecución sea igual o superior al 70 % del valor estimado del contrato. No obstante, y de conformidad con lo previsto en el art. 89 LCSP, cuando el contratista sea una empresa de nueva creación, entendiendo por esta, aquella que tenga una antigüedad inferior a cinco años, la solvencia técnica o posesional se acreditará mediante declaración indicando la relación del personal, integrada o no en la empresa, que adscribirá a la ejecución del contrato, así como la maquinaria, que, en cualquier caso y como mínimo, deberá constar de: - Medios materiales para la ejecución del servicio: - Camión o furgón grúa-pluma - Equipo técnico mínimo encargado de la ejecución del contrato: - Un profesional responsable del contrato que cuente con la titulación de Ingeniero Industrial o equivalente - Dos oficiales Se acreditará a través de los siguientes documentos: - Currículum vitae - Título habilitante

Netherlands – Road traffic-control equipment – Raamovereenkomst Levering Verkeersregeltoestellen
description: De afdeling Bereikbaarheid en Verkeersmanagement heeft als primaire taak het optimaal geleiden van alle verkeersstromen in en door de stad. Het verkeer in en rondom Den Haag wordt vanuit de Haagse Verkeerscentrale gemonitord, geïnformeerd en aangestuurd. Dit gebeurt met behulp van een samenhangend netwerk van circa 250 verkeersregelinstallaties (VRI’s), 72 dynamische route-informatiepanelen (DRIP’s), ongeveer 1.510 bewegwijzeringsobjecten en 140 verkeerscamera’s. Deze wegkantsystemen vervullen een cruciale functie. Het goed functioneren ervan moet continu gewaarborgd zijn om zowel de verkeersveiligheid als de doorstroming op peil te houden. Het verkeersregeltoestel vormt een essentieel onderdeel van een VRI. Het doel van deze opdracht is het inkopen van verkeersregeltoestellen, inclusief de verplichting tot tweedelijns onderhoud gedurende de volledige levensduur van het toestel.

title: Missouri Valley Levee Repairs
description: PRESOLICITATION NOTICEThe U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Kansas City District, anticipates issuing a solicitation and awarding a single contract for construction services to repair the Missouri Valley Levee. The Government intends to award a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) contract for this project. This will be a 100% Small Business Set-Aside competitive acquisition.The work covered by this contract consist of furnishing all equipment, labor, operators, supervision/site superintendent, quality control, supplies, materials, and incidentals necessary to satisfactorily perform and provide construction to potentially include, but not limited to earthwork operations, bringing in fill and borrow material from a pre-determined site, haul road development, clearing of debris as necessary, erosion repair, rutting repair, levee surfacing, various stone surfacing/placement, installation of stone armored protection, installation and rehabilitation of drainage structures and associated apertures, and establishment of turf for repairs of compromised landside, riverside, and crown levee sections.Currently, a Pre-Solicitation Conference is not scheduled. If the Government decides to hold a conference, this announcement will be amended accordingly.A site visit is planned for this solicitation. Details regarding the date, time, and location will be provided within the solicitation. Any changes to the site visit schedule will be communicated in the solicitation or through subsequent amendments, as applicable.No options are currently identified for this project.In accordance with FAR 36.204 and DFARS 236.204, the estimated magnitude of this construction project is between $100,000 and $250,000.The solicitation will be issued as an Invitation for Bid (IFB), open to all Small Businesses. Submission requirements and evaluation criteria will be detailed in the solicitation. The IFB will result in the award of a single Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) construction contract.The estimated performance period for completing construction is approximately 270 calendar days from the Notice to Proceed (NTP).A bid bond will be required with your proposal, amounting to 20% of the offerors proposed price or $3,000,000.00, whichever is less. Performance and Payment Bonds will be required for the full amount (100%) of the awarded contract before the Notice to Proceed can be issued.Bids will be due on the date and time specified in the solicitation.We anticipate releasing the solicitation within the next 60 days. By registering, you will be automatically notified of any changes to this notice, including the posting of the solicitation.The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this project is 237990, with a size standard of $45,000,000.00. Y1DA--EHRM Infrastructure Upgrades West Campus – North Chicago - Construction
description: Page 1 of 5 Department of MEMORANDUM Veterans Affairs Date: 2 October 2026 From: Contracting Officers Representative Subj: Contract: 36C77621C0096 EHRM Infrastructure Upgrades Construction - Captain James A. Lovell FHCC West Campus Justification and Approval Out-of-Scope Modification Other Than Full and Open Competition (FAR 6.302) Thru: Contracting Officer To: Contract File Contracting Activity: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC), 6100 Oak Tree Boulevard, Suite 490, Independence, OH 44131. Nature and/or Description of the Action Being Processed: The contracting activity plans to award an out-of-scope bi-lateral modification to existing firm-fixed price contract number 36C77623C0089 for the subject contract in accordance with VAAR 819.7004, 819.7005 and 819.7008 as interpreted by GAO Decision RCG of North Carolina, B-419691 which states: There is nothing in section 8127 of the Veterans Benefits Act that requires a contracting officer to make award to an SDVOSB on a competitive basis, rather than on a sole-source basis, where the same objective (i.e., award to an SDVOSB) will be met in either instance The original contract award was competed among VHA Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) SDVOSBs and awarded in the original amount of $42,597,900.00 to Povolny Group. Description of Supplies/Services Required to Meet the Agency s Needs: The requirement is to extend the VA.gov network from the in-campus Captain James A. Lovell FHCC West Campus to the on-site Fisher House. This effort will: Eliminate the current recurring $500 monthly fee associated with the GSU circuit network; Improve network performance by providing scalable connectivity of up to 10 Gbps or greater; and Extend the existing guest wireless network from the National Campus Hub (NCH) to the Fisher House facility. No DOT permits are required for this work. Estimated initial costs for directional boring and fiber-optic penetration to the nearest existing fiber connection point are approximately $203,160.74. This one-time investment is expected to eliminate recurring circuit costs and improve service reliability, resulting in a positive return on investment and net savings to the Government over the life of the contract. Statutory Authority Permitting Other than Full and Open Competition: 41 USC § 3304(a)(5), 38 U.S. Code § 8127 and VAAR 806.302-570 provides the express authority to use other than competitive procedures for sole source awards to verified veteran-owned small businesses. COs may use the non-competitive (sole source) procedures authorized by VAAR 819.7008 or 819.7009 for actions not to exceed $5,000,000. As prescribed in VAAR 806.302-570(a), full and open competition need not be provided for when awarding a sole source contract to a verified SDVOSB in accordance with 819.7008, as authorized. Further, a determination that only one SDVOSB can meet the requirement is not required. Demonstration that the Contractor s Unique Qualifications or Nature of the Acquisition Requires the Use of the Authority Cited Above (applicability of authority): The incumbent contractor holds the existing contract for EHRM infrastructure upgrades at the Captain James A. Lovell FHCC West Campus and possesses current, site-specific knowledge of the campus's existing fiber routes, telecommunications closets, and network architecture. This familiarity was gained through performance of the underlying contract and cannot be readily replicated by a new contractor without incurring duplicative site assessment, design, and mobilization costs. Because the Fisher House network extension is directly connected to, and dependent upon, the same backbone infrastructure the incumbent is already upgrading under the base contract, performing this work under a separate, competitively awarded contract would require a new contractor to remobilize to the site, independently verify as-built conditions already documented by the incumbent, and coordinate cutover activities with the incumbent's ongoing work. This would introduce schedule conflicts, increase the risk of service disruption to existing operational systems, and duplicate design and mobilization costs already sunk into the current effort. The incumbent is a verified SDVOSB with demonstrated technical capability to perform this work as an extension of its current scope, without disrupting infrastructure upgrades already underway or in place. Description of Efforts Made to ensure that offers are solicited from as many potential sources as deemed practicable: Because this action is proposed as a sole-source modification to an existing SDVOSB contract under the authority of VAAR 819.7008(b), a separate competitive solicitation for additional sources was not conducted for this specific increment of work. The Contracting Officer's determination to pursue a sole-source award rests on the following considerations: The base contract was itself competed among SDVOSB concerns in accordance with the rule of two, satisfying the statutory objective of directing the requirement to the SDVOSB community; Awarding the additional work as a separate, competed contract would require a new contractor to remobilize to an active construction site, duplicating site investigation and coordination work already performed by the incumbent; and The added cost and schedule risk associated with re-competing a comparatively small increment of work, and remobilizing a new contractor would outweigh any benefit gained from further competition, consistent with the GAO's recognition in B-419691 that a sole-source SDVOSB award meets the same statutory objective as a competitive one. In accordance with VAAR 819.7008(b), the decision to make a sole-source award to a verified SDVOSB is a business decision within the discretion of the Contracting Officer. The Contracting Officer has determined that the incumbent is a qualified, responsible SDVOSB capable of performing this requirement. Determination by the Contracting Officer (CO) that the Anticipated Cost to the Government will be Fair and Reasonable: The government will issue an RFP to the existing contractor for the change after developing the SOW and the IGE. The contractor will be required to submit cost or pricing data with their proposal. The Government estimate was prepared by the Contracting Officer s Representative (COR). The anticipated price for the Government is $203,160.74 When received the proposal will be evaluated by the COR and the proposal and its data will be the subject of rigorous cost analysis. The government s prenegotiation position will be based on costs proposed by the contractor, technical analysis of the proposal itself and other historical data. The contractor will be required to certify its cost or pricing data prior to modification award. Also, in accordance with FAR 15.406, FAR 15.403-5, and FAR 52.243-4; a price reasonableness determination will be made before modification award based on historical data, cost and/or price analysis, and negotiation. Description of the Market Research Conducted and the Results, or a Statement of the Reasons Market Research Was Not Conducted: Market research was conducted prior to award of the base contract. The final market research documentation was signed on 27 February 2023 and confirmed that an adequate number of SDVOSB concerns had been identified to satisfy the rule of two. Because this market research and the resulting competitive SDVOSB set-aside determination remain current and directly applicable to this requirement, additional market research specific to this modification is not necessary. description: The Tennessee Valley Healthcare System, VA Medical Center, 1310 24th Ave., S., Nashville, TN 37212 has a requirement for Project# 626-25-104 Garage Suicide Prevention. STATEMENT OF WORK Project: 626-25-104 Garage Suicide Prevention Scope of Work: The contractor shall furnish all labor, material, equipment, and supervision necessary to accomplish the work for 626-25-104 Garage Suicide Prevention at the Tennessee Valley Healthcare System, VA Medical Center, in accordance with the specifications and drawings. Work includes demolition and new construction, including, but not limited to general construction, civil, architectural, electrical, low voltage, industrial hygiene, and certain other items. Statement Of Bid Item(S) BID ITEMS: DEDUCT #1: Provide and install the fall deterrent system and lighting as shown in the drawings and specified in the project documents. DEDUCT #2: Deduct all lighting fixtures from the scope of this project. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS 1. All work, including materials, shall have a one-year warranty, or as noted in project specifications. 2. The contractor is to provide 10% spares for all lighting fixtures. 3. The contractor shall complete the work required under this statement of work (SOW) within 180 calendar days from issuance of the Notice to Proceed (NTP), which includes all work, submittals, material lead times, inspection, and closeout. 4. Medical Center normal working hours are Monday through Friday from 6 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. On-site work time should be managed to minimize the effect on the medical center. 5. The contractor will be required to work nights, weekends, and evenings to complete the work, to maintain the functionality of affected areas and to minimize disruptions to the Medical Center s operations. Before evening and weekend work begins, the project schedule shall be submitted by the contractor and approved by the VA COR one week before the work takes place. 6. Any shutdowns will require COR approval and a minimum of one week s notice. 7. The contractor will coordinate all work in advance with VA COR. 8. The VA retains the right to keep any existing lights after they are deinstalled. 9. The contractor superintendent and safety officer will always be on-site during the performance of the work associated with this contract. 10. When using furnish , provide , install , or similar term is used regarding all labor, materials, and equipment to perform the job it shall mean a complete installation that is ready for use. 11. The contractor shall identify all employees that will be working under the awarded contract. The contractor personnel shall include employees, sub-contractors, suppliers, and delivery personnel entering the medical center. Those employees shall bring one photo ID and a second form of state /federally issued ID to obtain a VA Contractor identification badge (REAL ID is required as one source of ID). A Passport or Social Security Card will suffice as the second form of ID. This badge must always be worn above the belt while on medical center property. The contractor s employees shall return all I.D. badges to designated personnel at the end of the period of performance of the contract. Lost badges will result in a surcharge. 12. The contractor's safety manager is responsible for safety inspections of all contract operations and will be identified to the contractor. All VA and OSHA safety regulations shall be observed during the performance of work. Provide signage and barricades, caution tape, warning lights etc as required, to maintain safety and protection of work around the project work site. Workers are required to utilize all PPE requirements per OSHA including but not limited to high-visibility safety vests, for workers safety. 13. Daily safety reports and daily construction reports are required - DAILY. 14. Additionally, on-site workers are screened daily at facility entrances prior to work. 15. The contractor shall visit the job site to thoroughly familiarize themselves with all the details of this work and working conditions. The contractor should also verify all dimensions in the field and should advise the CO and COR of any discrepancy before performing any work. The contractor shall be responsible for the coordination and proper relation of his work to the building, structure, phasing, ensuring the safety of employees, and workmen. 16. The contractor shall not allow smoking in any building or vehicle (located on VA property) and shall ensure employees do not smoke on VA property. This is a smoke free facility. Violation of VA directive will result in a Federal Fine. 17. The contractor will take adequate precautions to protect all adjacent equipment, concrete pads, and walkways in the work area from spills, drips, runs, and damage from the use of power tools. 18. The general contractor will be provided with two parking spaces (additional drivers of the general contractor will be issued a parking violation ticket). All others related to the project can utilize other paid parking lots/garages located off campus. The government isn t responsible for additional parking. Drivers should be particularly concerned with pedestrian traffic and yield to pedestrians. Seat Belt use is mandatory on all VA grounds. 19. The Contractor shall always keep the work area(s) free from the accumulation of waste materials. The Contractor shall remove from the work area and premises any rubbish, tools, scaffolding, equipment, and materials that are not the property of the Government. This includes the area outside of the building. If materials are stored on-site, they shall be organized and kept inside a conditioned storage space. A messy work area is dangerous; the COR has the authority to request that the site be cleaned in lieu of proceeding with work. The government is not providing storage space. Material in storage but not yet installed cannot be invoiced to the project. 20. Equipment (building service equipment and systems) shall be provided by nationally recognized manufacturers that produce and distribute equipment/ products across the United States for over 5 years. Manufacturers must have local vendor representation. Materials

description: Teil der Grundinstandsetzung der Mühlentorbrücke - Stahlkonstruktion als Zügelgurtbrücke - ist die Sanierung der Bestandskonstruktion. Ziel des Rückbaus und bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung des Transports ist der weitestgehende Erhalt der historischen Stahlkonstruktion bei möglichst geringen Eingriffen in die Bestandskonstruktion. Der verbleibende Überbau wird anschließend angehoben, in Richtung Mühlentorplatz längsverschoben, sukzessive durch selbstfahrende modulare Transportplattformen (SPMT) übernommen und auf dem Mühlentorplatz abgesetzt.

title: Grundinstandsetzung Mühlentorbrücke - Transport in Baulage
description: Teil der Grundinstandsetzung der Mühlentorbrücke - Stahlkonstruktion als Zügelgurtbrücke - ist die Sanierung der Bestandskonstruktion. Dabei erfolgt der Rückbau und Transport des Stahlgerüstes ca. 550 Tonnen an einen ca. 100 m entfernt gelegenen Standort in die Baulage. Hier wird der Korrosionsschutz erneuert. Ziel des Rückbaus und bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung des Transports ist der weitestgehende Erhalt der historischen Stahlkonstruktion bei möglichst geringen Eingriffen in die Bestandskonstruktion. Der Überbau wird in einem erleichterten Zustand ausgebaut. Hierzu werden zunächst die Hänger, Zügelgurte und Pylone sowie die stark korrodierten Brückenenden zurückgebaut. Der verbleibende Überbau wird anschließend angehoben, in Richtung Mühlentorplatz längsverschoben, sukzessive durch selbstfahrende modulare Transportplattformen (SPMT) übernommen und auf dem Mühlentorplatz abgesetzt.

title: Germany – Architectural and related services – Objektplanung Gebäude und Innenräume LPh 1-5
description: Auf dem Areal des ehemaligen Viehhofs befindet sich in unmittelbarer Nähe zum neuen Volkstheater die sog. Viehhofbank. Das Gebäude mit einer Bruttogrundfläche von insgesamt rund 3.800 m² wurde im Jahr 1914 nach den Plänen des Architekten Arnold Zenetti errichtet und steht unter Denkmalschutz. Das Gebäude diente seinerzeit nicht nur als finanzielles Fundament für den Viehhandel, sondern auch als zentraler Treffpunkt für die Gemeinschaft des Schlacht- und Viehhofareals. Es gilt auch, bedingt durch seine Lage, als zentraler Bestandteil des Viehhofs und spielte eine bedeutende Rolle in der regionalen Wirtschaft. Bis in die 1990er Jahre fand dort der Bankbetrieb statt. Später wurde das 2. OG als Berufsschule (bis 2006) genutzt. Das Gebäude steht seit rd. 20 Jahren überwiegend leer, im Erdgeschoss wird aktuell noch eine Teilfläche als Büro genutzt. Baukörper und Gebäudetechnik weisen zum Teil erhebliche Mängel auf. Im 1. OG wurden umfangreiche statische Hilfskonstruktionen eingebaut, um die zwischenzeitliche Nutzung des 2. OG als Berufsschule zu ermöglichen. Der Umgriff der ausgeschriebenen Planungsleistungen erstreckt sich auf das Bestandsgebäude (drei oberirdische Vollgeschosse, ein Dach- und ein Untergeschoss) mit einer Bruttogrundfläche von rd. 3.800 m² und die direkt angrenzenden Grundstücksflächen. Ziel ist es, ein möglichst flexibles Nutzungskonzept zu entwickeln, das im DG (ist neu auszubauen), 2. OG und 1. OG eine Büronutzung (alternativ Ateliers) und im EG eine Fläche für Versammlungen, Ausstellungen und Veranstaltungen vorsieht. Gegenstand dieses Auftrags ist die Objektplanung Gebäude und Innenräume LPh 1-5. Nähere Angaben siehe Ziffer 5.1.

title: Luonnonvarakeskuksen kalanviljelylaitoksen ruokinnanohjausjärjestelmä
description: Luonnonvarakeskuksen kalanviljelylaitoksen ruokinnanohjausjärjestelmä Luonnonvarakeskus (Luke) uudistaa Inarin kalanviljelylaitoksen kalaston ruokinnanohjausjärjestelmän, joka perustuu kalabiologiaan. Kalanviljelylaitoksella on kolme erillistä viljelyhallia (B-, C- ja D-hallit), joissa on yhteensä noin 130 allasta. Osassa altaista on kaksi ruokintalaitetta. Hankinnalla korvataan nykyinen pc-ohjattu ItuMic-ruokinnanohjausjärjestelmä. Halleissa käytössä oleva Pellon astrokellovalaistus on toimiva, eikä sen uusiminen lähtökohtaisesti kuulu hankinnan piiriin. B-hallin osalta hankintaan sisältyy koko ruokinnanohjausjärjestelmän uusiminen tarvittavine asennuksineen, johdotuksineen, sähkö- ja käyttöönottotöineen sekä etäkäyttömahdollisuuden toteuttaminen yhteyksineen. Järjestelmän tulee mahdollistaa vähintään veden lämpötilan seuranta. C-hallissa uusitaan kaapelointi nykyiseltä ruokinnanohjausjärjestelmän keskukselta kaikille altaille. Nykyisen kaapeloinnin kapasiteetti ei ole riittävä tulevia tarpeita varten. Kaapelointi toteutetaan siten, että se palvelee myös myöhemmin mahdollisesti käyttöön otettavia ruokinnanohjausjärjestelmiä, ruokintalaitteita ja rehulevittimiä. C-hallin kaapeloinnissa on huomioitava altaiden pitkä etäisyys ruokintakeskuksesta, pisimmillään yli 100 metriä. D-hallissa hankintaan sisältyy nykyisen kaapeloinnin muokkaaminen uusien rehulevittimien testaamiseksi valituissa altaissa. Lisäksi hankitaan ruokinta-automaatteja sekä niihin soveltuvia sektorisäädettäviä rehulevittimiä. Rehulevittimiä hankitaan yhteensä neljä (4) kappaletta siten, että kaksi (2) rehulevitintä soveltuu pienemmälle rehulle (noin 1,7–5 mm, poikaset) ja kaksi (2) rehulevitintä suuremmalle rehulle (enintään 9 mm, emokalat). Rehulevittimiä käytetään noin 50 m²:n (halkaisija 8 m) ja 28 m²:n (halkaisija 6 m) altaissa. Hankinnassa käytettävät rehut ovat Fennoaquan ja Biomarin valmistamia. Hankittavien ruokinta-automaattien lopullinen määrä määräytyy tarjotun yksikköhinnan ja hankintaan käytettävissä olevan määrärahan perusteella.,

title: CA18703 - Barwell Infant School _ Leicester
description: Barwell Infant School is seeking a catering partner who can deliver fresh, nutritious, and appealing meals that children genuinely want to eat. We believe that food is a fundamental part of the school day-supporting wellbeing, fuelling learning, and helping pupils develop healthy habits that last far beyond their time with us. The ideal partner will act with honesty, integrity, and a clear commitment to putting pupils at the centre of every decision. From menu design to service style, we expect a caterer who consistently asks, "What is best for the children?" and demonstrates this through their actions, communication, and daily practice. Lunchtimes at Barwell Infant School must be enjoyable, vibrant, and inclusive. Tenuto conto delle attività di installazione delle infrastrutture di ricarica da eseguirsi presso il deposito del soggetto gestore, sono stati stimati in € 22.500,00 (euro ventiduemilacinquecento/00) i costi della sicurezza da interferenze, non soggetti a ribasso. Pertanto l'importo complessivo posto a base d'asta è pari ad € 9.250.000,00 (euro novemilioniduecentocinquantamila/00) oltre costi della sicurezza da interferenze non soggetti a ribasso (pari ad € 22.500,00). Gli autobus oggetto del presente appalto verranno utilizzati per il trasporto passeggeri nell’area della Città di Taranto; il profilo di missione è indicato nell’ Allegato 1 al capitolato Il profilo climatico della Regione Puglia è fornito in Allegato 2 al capitolato. L’appalto è finanziato con risorse del Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti, a valere sul Piano Strategico Nazionale della Mobilità Sostenibile (PSNMS) giusta Decreto Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti n. 152 del 08.05.2025.

title: Drift av Sunnhordlandsruta
description: Skyss er Vestland fylkeskommune si administrasjonseining som planlegg, kjøper og marknadsfører dei kollektivtransporttenester som Vestland fylkeskommune har ansvar for. Skyss tildeler kontraktar for køyring av buss, bybane, båt og ferjer i Vestland til operatørselskap etter konkurransar. I tillegg er Skyss sine oppgåver ruteplanlegging, utvikling av billettsystem, informasjon og marknadsføring av kollektivtilbodet. Føremålet med anskaffinga er å få på plass båtoperatør for drift av Sunnhordlandsruta. For meir informasjon om krav til gjennomføring av kontrakten, sjå Kontraktsdokumentet for krav til leveransen i kap. 2, krav til fartøya i kap. 3, krav til ruteproduksjonen i kap. 4 og klimakrav i kap. 5. Oppdragsgjevar vil inngå ein kontrakt for drift av båtruta. Kontrakten vil gjelde frå tidspunkt for signering til og med 1. desember 2045, jf Kontraktens punkt 1.1.5. Driftsoppstart skal vere 02. desember 2030. Det stilles krav til maksimalt utslipp frå drifta, sjå krav definert i Kontrakten kap 5 og begrunnelse i Prosedyreskildringa. Estimat utan omsyn til støtte frå Klimasats: Skyss estimerar årleg kontraktssum til om lag 180-221 MNOK og estimerte eingongskostnader knytt til energiinfrastruktur, nettoppgradering og kaiutbetring til 83-114 MNOK. Dette tilsvarar 2785-3433 MNOK totalt for heile kontraktens varigheit. Annualisert utgjer dette 186-229 MNOK per år. Støtte frå Klimasats som Oppdragsgjevar mottek er ikkje omsyntatt i desse tala. Estimata omfatter heller ikke kontraktens endringsrettar og opsjoner, til dømes oppdragsgjevars rett til å auke ruteproduksjonen, adgang til å krevje innsetting av større og/eller ekstra fartøy endringsrettar, rett til å auke klimakravet etc. Kostnadsestimata er oppgjeve tredje kvartal 2025-kroner. Estimat fråtrukken støtte frå Klimasats: Estimert kontraktsverdi inkludert engongskostnader og fråtrukken støtte frå Klimasats er estimert til om lag 170-214 MNOK per år, dvs 2 554-3 220 MNOK for heile kontraktsperioden. Kostnadsestimata er oppgjeve tredje kvartal 2025-kroner.

title: Telemetry Engineering Support Services
description:
Scottish Water is establishing a Framework Agreement for Telemetry Engineering Support Services, covering the survey, supply, installation, commissioning, decommissioning and documentation of Remote Telemetry Units (RTUs) and associated communications equipment across Scottish Water's water and wastewater asset base, together with reactive telemetry support. Services may be required anywhere in Scotland, so Suppliers must be able to service all geographic areas.

The scope includes, but is not limited to:

- Desktop and on-site surveys of existing and future telemetry installations, including communications surveys (e.g. 4G, SOGEA, FTTP).
- Procurement of RTUs and associated equipment through Scottish Water's mandatory RTU framework, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) prior to delivery to site.
- Supply and installation of RTU associated communications equipment in accordance with Scottish Water specifications (antennas, surge and lightning protection, cable containment, marshalling, relays, signal conditioners, Modbus PLC communications, data gatherers and inter-site comms).
- Programming and end to end (source to screen) commissioning and testing of new and existing plant monitored by the telemetry top end, including hot swaps of live RTUs.
- Decommissioning of RTUs and associated equipment, including safe removal, return of spares and WEEE compliant disposal.
- Production of IO tag sheets, mimics, risk assessments and method statements, commissioning and FAT records, Ready to Go Live documentation and Operation and Maintenance manuals, in line with Scottish Water procedures and a Common Data Environment aligned to ISO 19650.
- Training for Scottish Water Electrical and Mechanical (E&M) support staff on installed telemetry.
- Additional on-site support to Scottish Water E&M teams for communications failures, reactive faults and minor enhancements, and to supplement Scottish Water maintenance teams during periods of high breakdown volumes or staff shortages.

Work will be delivered on assets within Scottish Water's Operational Technology environment, which is in scope of the Network and Information Systems (NIS) Regulations, in accordance with Scottish Water's Telemetry Realisation Process, telemetry procedures and Engineering Specification Section 633 - Telemetry. The Supplier will act as Principal Contractor only and must provide its own base facilities, as Scottish Water will not make premises available.

Call-off contracts will be awarded under the Framework by direct allocation or mini-competition. Scottish Water may appoint more than one Supplier. Appointment to the Framework does not guarantee any volume or value of work.

This opportunity is aimed at telemetry, SCADA, instrumentation and controls and electrical engineering contractors with proven capability in delivering telemetry installations on operational water and wastewater assets, a competent and suitably qualified workforce, and the capacity to respond across Scotland.

title: ROKS TP5: Sanierung Triebwasserweg S-chanf-Ova Spin Los 2 – Betonsanierung und Fahrbahnabdichtung Unteres Aquädukt
description:
Im Rahmen des Projekts «ROKS TP5: Sanierung Triebwasserweg S-Chanf - Ova Spin» werden am Unteren Aquädukt Betonsanierungen an den Aussenwänden sowie eine Erneuerung der Abdichtung der Fahrbahnplatten ausgeführt.

Das Untere Aquädukt befindet sich in der Ortschaft S-chanf und wurde in den Jahren 1965–1966 erstellt. Das Bauwerk überspannt den Inn und besteht aus einer zweifeldrigen Spannbetonbrücke in Hohlkastenbauweise mit geschlossenem Querschnitt. Der zentrale Pfeiler ist rund 17.2 m hoch und im Flussbett des Inns fundiert. Das Bauwerk weist eine Gesamtlänge von 78 m auf und ist als Zweifeldsystem mit zwei Spannweiten von je 39 m ausgebildet. Der Hohlkasten besitzt eine konstante Bauhöhe von 4.85 m. Die durchgeführten Untersuchungen zur Bestimmung des Zustands haben lokale Korrosionserscheinungen an den Hüllrohren der Spannglieder aufgezeigt. Daher sind kurzfristig Betoninstandsetzungsarbeiten erforderlich.

Die Realisierung von Mai bis Oktober 2027 vorgesehen.

Die ausgeschriebenen Arbeiten umfassen insbesondere:

-      Betonsanierung mit punktueller Freilegung der Vorspannung (Aussenwände Hohlkasten). Der Betonabtrag ist abschnittsweise und zwingend in Etappen von maximal 1.0 m Breite auszuführen.

-      Vollflächige Applizierung einer Spachtelung und einer Hydrophobierung an den Aussenwänden und teilweise an der Unterseite des Hohlkastens.

-      Abbruch der bestehenden Konsolköpfe und Geländer, Neubau Konsolköpfe und Einbau neuer Geländer.

-      Abbruch des bestehenden Belages bis zum Betonuntergrund, Erstellung eines neuen Fahrbahnabdichtungssystems (Polymerbitumendichtungsbahnen und Gussasphalt).

Hauptmengen:

Fahrbahn:

-      Demontage bestehende Geländer: 156 m

-      Abbruch bestehender Konsolkopf: 156 m

-      Beton NPK G (neuer Konsolkopf): 70 m3

-      Neue Geländer: 156 m

-      Abbruch bestehender Belag: 280 m2

-      Abbruch bestehende Abdichtung: 320 m2

-      Neues Abdichtungssystem (PBD Bahn): 280 m2

-      Neuer Belag (Gussasphalt): 66 t

Aussenwände Hohlkasten

-      Lokale Betoninstandsetzung (Abtrag schadhafter Beton und Reprofilierung mit Mörtel R4): ca. 100 m2

Vollflächige Spachtelung und Hydrophobierung: ca. 940 m2

title: APN - CETEMT New Facility and Compound, CFB Uplands
description: Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform the Design-Builder of an upcoming contract opportunity at CFB Uplands in Ottawa, Ontario. The purpose of this APN is to allow the Design-Builder to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested Design-Builders to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that this project will include an Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process.   Description of the Project and Services   This contract will provide the design and construction of the new facility and compound near the existing CETEMT (Counter Explosive Threat Equipment Management Team) compound at CFB Uplands. The new facility will be a single-storey building with an approximate footprint of 1,650 m2. It will include offices and workspaces, meeting rooms, maintenance garages and workshops, specialized spaces such as secure storage and a weapons vault, and support areas including a kitchenette, washrooms, and server rooms. The facility will be situated within a new exterior compound of approximately 6,500 m2, including parking areas.   The delivery method for this infrastructure will be a Modified Design-Build (MDB) contract. ROM estimate for the total value of the MDB contract is approximately $17M. It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND.   Contract Number: 88076 Title: CETEMT New Facility and Compound Approximate Estimate: $ 17M Anticipated Posting: Q4 FY26/27 Description: Provide the Counter Explosive Threat Equipment Management Team (CETEMT) a new facility and compound on CFB Uplands in Ottawa, Ontario according to operational requirements.   Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a Design-Builder will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated industrial security requirements of this project will be at FSC Secret. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing Design-Builders  early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, Design-Builders that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential Design-Builders with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants or contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number 88076; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants or contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. description: Portfolio Acquisition Executive Maritime (PAEM) is issuing solicitation N6117727R5000 for the award of Southwest Regional Maintenance Center (SWRMC) Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity Multiple Award Contracts (IDIQ-MACs) for Continuous Maintenance Availabilities (CMAVs), Emergent Maintenance (EM), and short-term Chief of Naval Operations (CNO) availabilities. This solicitation is for the procurement of maintenance, repair and modernization of non-nuclear surface ships (including Guided-Missile Cruisers (CGs), Guided Missile Destroyers (DDGs), Expeditionary Sea Bases (ESBs), Guided-Missile Frigates (FFGs), Amphibious Command Ships (LCCs), Littoral Combat Ships (LCSs), Landing Helicopter Assaults (LHAs), Landing Helicopter Docks (LHDs), Landing Platform Docks (LPDs), Landing Ship Docks (LSDs), and Mine Countermeasures Ships (MCMs) homeported in or visiting the San Diego region. PAEM intends to award IDIQ-MACs based on the qualifications and capabilities of the Contractor in the following two categories: MAC A, where all holders can complete all requirements; and MAC B, where all holders can complete work associated with CMAVs and EM on non-critical systems. MAC A: MAC A will be solicited on a full and open basis. CMAV/EM includes work on critical systems. MAC A also includes short-term CNO availabilities. Due to the nature of critical systems and the likelihood of urgent requirements with critical EM, the Government will require contractors with the capability and capacity to respond immediately to critical technical requirements. MAC B: MAC B will be solicited as a Small Business Set Aside. CMAV/EM does not include work on critical systems but will include systems and equipment requiring work certification. The scope of non-critical contract actions is expected to require less contractor capabilities, both in human resources and facilities. All MAC A and MAC B offerors must possess or have the ability to obtain a Tier I, II, or III Master Ship Repair Agreement (MSRA) for the San Diego, CA homeport. Each contract will include five (5) one-year ordering periods. The supply being procured is the repaired, mission ready vessel, which is returned to service within the Fleet. This solicitation is issued electronically via PIEE and interested offerors should monitor PIEE and SAM.gov for any applicable solicitation amendments, thereafter.

title: Germany – Drinking-water treatment plant construction work – Neubau Wasserwerk Oldenburg-Alexandersfeld
description: Aufbereitungsanlage zur Enteisenung und Entmanganung: Es handelt sich um ein Gebäude der Gebäudeklasse 3, in Außenabmessungen von 36,25 m x 34,60 m x 12,30 m (L x B x H). Der Bemessungswasserstand wurde mit 10,00 m NHN ca. 1,6 m unter der mittleren Geländeoberkante (11,60 m NHN) festgelegt. Eine Grundwasserhaltung würde daher nur im Bereich der Pumpensümpfe und ggf. des Doppelbodens benötigt. Darüber hinaus ist die Baugrube von anfallendem Tag- und Regenwasser trockenzuhalten. Das geplante Gebäude wird in einer Hybridbauweise aus Massiv- und Stahlskelettbau errichtet. Es gliedert sich konstruktiv und visuell in zwei Ebenen. Die untere Hälfte besteht aus Stahlbetonwänden, welche mit einer Vorsatzschale aus Klinker verkleidet sind. Darauf wird eine Stahlhalle mit asymmetrischem Satteldach aufgesetzt, welche mit Sandwichpaneelen verkleidet wird. Das Dach wird vollständig mit einer PV-Anlage versehen. Der notwendige Dachzugang wird über eine Lichtkuppel gewährleistet. Die Sicherung auf dem Dach erfolgt über ein Sekurantensystem. Das innere der TWA gliedert sich in drei Ebenen. In der massiven Ebene 0 befinden sich im südwestlichen Gebäudetrakt die elektrotechnischen Betriebsräume sowie die Netzersatzanlage inkl. des dazugehörigen Tankraums. Im mittleren Gebäudeteil öffnet sich die Halle nach oben, sodass die verfahrenstechnischen Komponenten (v. a. die erste Filterstufe inkl. dazugehöriger Peripherie), für die dieser Zweckbau vorrangig errichtet wird, frei über alle Ebenen verspringen können. Im nordöstlichen Gebäudesegment stehen drei Filterkammern aus WU-Beton, die als zweite Filterstufe fungieren. Die drei Betonfilter werden in diesem TWA-Abschnitt durch eine optional nutzbare Wasserkammer und einen Flockungsmittelraum ergänzt. In Ebene 1 befinden sich über dem ET-Trakt die Betriebs- und Sozialräume inkl. Warte, Werkstatt, Lager, Untersuchungsraum, Um-kleide und Sanitärbereich. Von diesem Bereich führt eine Gitterrostbühne auf die andere Gebäudeseite über dem Flockungsmittelraum und der optionalen Wasserkammer. Dabei gehört der Raum für die Lufttechnik noch zu Ebene 1. In Ebene 2, die sich über den drei Betonfiltern befindet, werden drei Zwischenbelüfter über den Filterkammern installiert. Über weitere Stahlbühnenabschnitte werden Möglichkeiten zur Begehung und Wartung der Beton- und Stahlfilter gewährleistet. Unter dem Dach der Aufbereitungshalle wird eine geschwungene Kranbahn (Nutzlast 2 to) vorgesehen, welche über alle notwendigen Ebenen führt. Für den Innenausbau wird zweckgebunden unterschieden. Die Wandflächen der Aufbereitungshalle und weiterer technischer Räume werden weiß gestrichen. Die Gestaltung der Bodenflächen besteht nutzungs-abhängig aus rutschhemmenden Fliesen in der Aufbereitungshalle, bei den Flachbettbelüftern und den Lüftungsaggregaten, aus Doppelbodensystem aus Platten oder Gitterrost für die Böden der Elektrotechnik sowie aus Industrievinyl für die Sozial- und Arbeitsräume über dem Elektrotrakt. Die Wände in den Sozial-räumen werden verputzt und weiß gestrichen. Die Türen sind raum-abhängig entweder aus Holz mit Umfassungszarge oder aus Aluminium mit Blockzarge herzustellen. Geländer, Tribünen und Treppen werden aus feuerverzinktem Stahl hergestellt, die dazugehörigen Handläufe allerdings aus Edelstahl.

description: A23 Tunnel Stadlau/Hirschstetten: Die Tunnel Stadlau und Hirschstetten sind Teil der A23 und stellen die Verbindung zwischen dem Knoten Kaisermühlen und der S2 dar. Aufgrund der hohen Verkehrsbelastung kommt es im Nahbereich der Tunnel und auch in den Tunnel insbesondere während der Stoßzeiten häufig zu Stau. Die Tunnelkette stellt mit den beiden Tunnelanlagen und der dazwischenliegenden BZ Stadlau eine funktionale Einheit dar. Die Tunnelanlagen wurden in offener Bauweise errichtet: Die BZ ist ein freistehender Hochbau mit einem Installationskollektor unter den RFB’en, aus dem die Kabeltröge beider Tunnelanlagen erschlossen werden. Die BZ weist nur sehr geringe Platzreserven auf. In Fahrtrichtung S2 (RFB1) befindet sich der Tunnel Stadlau mit 465m, welcher eine Verkehrsverflechtung mit der Tunnelrampe R20 mit 125m, Ausfahrt Stadlau, aufweist und der Tunnel Hirschstetten mit 285m. In Fahrtrichtung Knoten Kaisermühlen (RFB2) befindet sich der Tunnel Hirschstetten mit 500m, beim Portal mündet die Tunnelrampe R3 mit 184m und danach eine Feuerwehrzufahrt zwischen den beiden Tunnelanlagen in die A23, danach folgt der Tunnel Stadlau mit 465m.

Lot 2, SIEM/SOC : exploitation du SIEM et du SOC (7j/7, 24h/24), y compris la réponse aux incidents de sécurité (Security Incident Response).

Lot 4, Expertise : architecture des données et gouvernance des données, architecture d'entreprise, innovation technologique et gestion de la sortie (Exit Management), sur demande. Les offres peuvent être déposées pour un, plusieurs ou la totalité des lots.
